lines.trans: Everything in the world always changes.
New cities are built and grow.
Millions of new people are born.
In our kitchen the day begins the same way.
Vitya, when will you make the new menu?
You promised me a new summer menu.
What summer menu, Vika?
Why do people need new dishes in summer?
Hello to everyone in our kitchen!
Viktoria Sergeyevna, I did not notice right away.
The chef has been promising a menu for two months already.
After all, summer will end soon.
What a sly chef we have!
